ambiguities.description: The mandatory/optionality and cardinality of the Student enrolls in CourseOffering fact type is not explicit -- can a student enroll in multiple offerings simultaneously, is enrollment mandatory for a student, and can an offering have zero enrolled students? Also no uniqueness constraint is stated to prevent a student from being enrolled twice in the same offering.

source_references.excerpt: Students enroll in course offerings, not in courses directly.

ambiguities.description: It's unclear whether the letter grade is only assigned to students who completed enrollment, and whether every enrolled student is guaranteed to eventually receive a grade (mandatory participation of CourseOffering/Student roles in the grade fact type is unclear -- e.g., what about a student who withdraws?).

source_references.excerpt: At the end of a semester, a student receives a letter grade for each course offering they were enrolled in.

ambiguities.description: The credit value range (1 to 6) is described as 'usually' rather than a strict rule, so it's ambiguous whether this is a hard value constraint or just a typical range that could have exceptions.

source_references.excerpt: The credit value is a whole number, usually between 1 and 6.

ambiguities.description: Maximum capacity enforcement is mentioned as a cap on enrollment, but no explicit constraint ties the count of Student enrollments per CourseOffering to the MaximumCapacity value -- this business rule (enrollment count <= max capacity) is implied but not formalized as a constraint since it involves a derived count compared against a stored value.

source_references.excerpt: Each offering has a maximum capacity -- a cap on how many students can enroll.

ambiguities.description: It is not specified whether a Course can exist without ever being offered (optionality of the Course side of 'CourseOffering is of Course'), nor whether a Semester can exist without any offerings.

source_references.excerpt: Each offering is of exactly one course and belongs to exactly one semester.

ambiguities.description: No historical tracking is mentioned for instructor assignment to an offering, or for enrollment -- if an instructor changes for an offering mid-semester, or a student drops, is history needed? The transcript only describes current-state facts.
